title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A switch that only worked once
summary: Last release taught the Remove unused quick fixes to skip their startup scan when the setting is off. It read the setting once and never looked again, so the switch only worked in one direction and at one moment.

highlights.title: Turning it on primes the scan
highlights.description: Before, the setting was only read at startup, so the next lightbulb ran a full project scan itself, which is the wait the warm up exists to avoid.

highlights.title: Turning it off gives the memory back
highlights.description: The scan holds the text of every source, 40.8 MB across 6278 files on the project measured. That was kept for the rest of the session.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The quick fix provider now follows its setting both ways instead of reading it once at startup.
It listens to that setting, so it is disposed with the rest of the extension. Built inline inside its registration, nothing could release it.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A guard in the test suite fails if either entry point goes back to building the provider inline.
